snippet.title: Kaporanga - Trailer EN
snippet.description:
Kaporanga is a local and online party game for up to 8 players of all ages, packed with minigames set across iconic locations in Rio de Janeiro. It’s free and accessible! Grab your friends, cousins, or even the parrot, and get ready for some wild fun and friendly chaos. Time to Kaporanga!

Play it for free on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665430/Kaporanga/

Learn more at: aperoboto.com
